3603: כִּכָּר _n.f_. **a round**: hence 1. **a round district**. 2. **a round loaf**. 3. **a round weight**, **talent**
3605:
כֹּל once כּוֹל _n.m_. **the whole**, **all**
**1.** with foll. gen. (as usually) **the whole of**, to be rendered, however, often in our idiom, to avoid stiffness, **any** or **every**
**2.** Absolutely:
**a.** without the art., **all things**, **all**
**b.** with the art. הַכֹּל
**(a).** where the sense is limited by the context to things (or persons) just mentioned
**(b).** in a wider sense, **all**, whether of all mankind or of all living things, the universe, or of all the circumstances of life (chiefly late)
3607:
[כָּלָא] _vb_. **shut up**, **restrain**, **withhold** (NH _id_.; Aram. כְּלָא, _Syriac_; Eth. _Ethiopic_ **restrain**, **hinder**; As. _kâlû_, _id_.; Ar. _Arabic_ **protect** Qor 21:43 cf. Ba ZMG 1887, 605 Anm. 4)—
**Qal** Pf. 3 ms. sf. כְּלָאוֹ [[24-jeremiah.32.3|Je 32:3]]; 3 fs. כָּֽלְאָה [[37-haggai.1.10|Hg 1:10]]; 2 fs. sf. כְּלִתִ֫נִי [[09-1-samuel.25.33|I S 25:33]]; 1 s. כָּלִאתִי [[19-psalms.119.101|ψ 119:101]]; 3 pl. כָּֽלְאוּ [[37-haggai.1.10|Hg 1:10]], כָּלוּ [[09-1-samuel.6.10|I S 6:10]]; Impf. 3 ms. יִכְלֶה [[01-genesis.23.6|Gn 23:6]]; 2 ms. תִכְלָא [[19-psalms.40.12|ψ 40:12]]; 2 fs. תִּכְלָ֑אִי [[23-isaiah.43.6|Is 43:6]]; 1 s. אֶכְלָא [[19-psalms.40.10|ψ 40:10]]; Imv. sf. כְּלָאֵֽם [[04-numbers.11.28|Nu 11:28]]; Inf. cstr. לִכְלוֹא [[21-ecclesiastes.8.8|Ec 8:8]]; Pt. pass. כָלוּא [[24-jeremiah.32.2|Je 32:2]], כָּלֻא [[19-psalms.88.9|ψ 88:9]]; (on the metapl. forms, as if fr. כלה, v. Ges § 76, 21 c Kö i. 611);—
**1.** **shut up**, c. acc. [[09-1-samuel.6.10|I S 6:10]] (+ בְ loc.), [[24-jeremiah.32.3|Je 32:3]]; pt. pass. [[24-jeremiah.32.2|Je 32:2]] (בְ loc.), fig. [[19-psalms.88.9|ψ 88:9]] (opp. יצא).
**2.** **restrain**, c. acc. [[09-1-samuel.25.33|I S 25:33]] (+ מִבּוֹא בְדָמִים), [[19-psalms.119.101|ψ 119:101]] (+ מִכָּל־); כְּלָאֵם (sc. מֵהִתְנַבֵּא) [[04-numbers.11.28|Nu 11:28]]; כ׳ שְׂפָתַי [[19-psalms.40.10|ψ 40:10]]; כ׳ אֶת־הָרוּחַ [[21-ecclesiastes.8.8|Ec 8:8]]. On [[19-psalms.74.11|ψ 74:11]] v. כלה **Pi**. 2.
**3.** **withhold**, כ׳ אֶת־קִבְרוֹ מִמְּךָ מִקְּבֹר מֵתֶֽךָ [[01-genesis.23.6|Gn 23:6]] (P), כ׳ רַחֲמֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי [[19-psalms.40.12|ψ 40:12]], Hg 1:10 b, prob. also [[37-haggai.1.10|v a]] (rd. מָ֑ל for MT 𝔊 מִטָּ֑ל, We); abs. אַל־תִּכְלָאִי (sc. exiles) [[23-isaiah.43.6|Is 43:6]] (∥ תְּנִי).
**Niph**. Impf. וַיִּכָּלֵא הַגֶּשֶׁם מִן־הַשָּׁמָיִם [[01-genesis.8.2|Gn 8:2]] (J), **and the rain from heaven was restrained**, cf. וַיִּכָּלְאוּ מַיִם רַבִּים [[26-ezekiel.31.15|Ez 31:15]] (in fig.; ∥ מנע); וַיִּכָּלֵא הָעָם מֵהָבִיא [[02-exodus.36.6|Ex 36:6]] (P).
**Pi**. [Pf. כִּלָּא and] Inf. cstr. לְכַלֵּא v. כלה **Pi**.

3611:
כֶּ֫לֶב _n.m_. [[09-1-samuel.24.15|I S 24:15]] **dog** (NH _id_.; Ph. כלב; Aram. כֶּ֫לְבָּא, _Syriac_; Ar. _Arabic_; Eth. _Ethiopic_ As. _kalbu_ DI HWB 328)—abs. כ׳ [[07-judges.7.5|Ju 7:5]] + 16 t., כָּ֑לֶב [[19-psalms.59.7|ψ 59:7]], [[19-psalms.59.15|15]]; pl. כְּלָבִים [[11-1-kings.14.11|1 K 14:11]] + 12 t.; cstr. כַּלְבֵי [[18-job.30.1|Jb 30:1]]; sf. כְּלָבֶיךָ [[19-psalms.68.24|ψ 68:24]];—**dog**:
**a.** lit. [[11-1-kings.14.11|1 K 14:11]] [[11-1-kings.16.4|16:4]] [[11-1-kings.21.19|21:19]], [[11-1-kings.21.19|19]], [[11-1-kings.21.23|23]], [[11-1-kings.21.24|24]] [[11-1-kings.22.38|22:38]] [[12-2-kings.9.10|2 K 9:10]], [[12-2-kings.9.36|36]] (all of fierce, hungry dogs, devouring dead bodies and licking blood); cf. [[24-jeremiah.15.3|Je 15:3]] and (לְשׁוֹן כְּלָבֶיךָ) [[19-psalms.68.24|ψ 68:24]]; eating torn flesh, [[02-exodus.22.30|Ex 22:30]] (E), כַּלְבֵי צֹאנִי = **my sheep-dogs**, only [[18-job.30.1|Jb 30:1]] (in both these with implied inferiority); dog-sacrifice was a heathen rite [[23-isaiah.66.3|Is 66:3]] (Di al.); v. esp. RS Sem. 1, 273 (291), 325 (343); in various sim. [[07-judges.7.5|Ju 7:5]] [[20-proverbs.26.11|Pr 26:11]], [[20-proverbs.26.17|17]] [[19-psalms.59.7|ψ 59:7]], [[19-psalms.59.15|15]]; in proverbial sayings: לֹא יֶֽחֱרַץ־כ׳ לְשֹׁנוֹ [[02-exodus.11.7|Ex 11:7]] (v. **b.** applied, fig., to men, in contempt [[09-1-samuel.17.43|I S 17:43]], so of psalmist’s enemies [[19-psalms.22.17|ψ 22:17]], [[19-psalms.22.21|21]], or in excessive humility [[12-2-kings.8.13|2 K 8:13]]; still more emphatically כ׳ מֵת **a dead dog**, הָכּ׳ הַמֵּת [[10-2-samuel.9.8|2 S 9:8]] [[10-2-samuel.16.9|16:9]]; also רֹאשׁ כ׳ [[10-2-samuel.3.8|3:8]]; כְּלָבִים אִלְּמִים [[23-isaiah.56.10|Is 56:10]] (of misleading prophets), הַכּ׳ עַזֵּי נֶפֶשׁ [[23-isaiah.56.11|v 11]] (_id_.); כ׳ was name given to male temple-prostitutes [[05-deuteronomy.23.19|Dt 23:19]] (v. 3615:
כָּלָה 204 _vb_. **be complete**, **at an end**, **finished**, **accomplished**, **spent**
**Qal**
**1.**
**a.** **be complete**, **at an end**, of a period of time
**b.** **be completed**, **finished**, of a work
**c.** **be accomplished**, **fulfilled**
**d.** be idealy complete, **be determined**, always in a bad sense, **plotted**
**2.**
**a.** **be spent**, **used up** (prop. **come to an end**), of water
**b.** **waste away**, **be exhausted**, **fail**
**c.** **come to an end**, **vanish** = **perish**, **be destroyed**
**Pi**.
**1.**
**a.** **complete**, **bring to an end**, **finish**, a thing, task, work, etc.
**b.** **complete** a period of time
**c.** **finish** doing a thing
**d.** **make an end**, **end**
**e.** **accomplish**, **fulfil**, **bring to pass**
**f.** **accomplish** in thought, **determine**
**2.**
**a.** **put an end to**, **cause to cease**
**b.** **cause to fail**, **exhaust**, **use up**, **spend**
**c.** **destroy**, sts. **exterminate**
